The workspace patch/assertions identify only the three intended Moldea changes, and deterministic-after reports valid inspection, validation, typecheck, and unchanged repository state during checks.

The workspace patch preserves the original opening (`# Support agent` and `You are the support agent...`) and adds guidance directing refund and invoice questions to `/moldea/context/billing.md`, limiting answers to established evidence and requiring escalation for unresolved disputes.
